title: Black Friday 2026: Disney+ & Hulu Bundle Is More Than 60% Off for 12 Months
summary: For a limited time, subscribers get one year of Disney+ and Hulu for just $4.99 per month (was $12.99 per month).
contentText:

$4.99/month $12.99/month 62% off

Get Disney+ & Hulu Bundle

If you don’t want commercial breaks when watching programming, then you can upgrade to the premium bundle for $14.99 per month for 12 months (was $21.99 per month). It’s still an impressive discount of 32% for the annual plan. With the premium bundle, you’d go ad-free and would be able to download select movies and TV shows to your smartphone or tablet via the Disney+ mobile app.

What’s Streaming on Disney+ & Hulu?

The Disney+ and Hulu Bundle is the streaming home to hit originals, including Percy Jackson and the Olympians , VisionQuest , Only Murders in the Building , The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County , The Devil Wears Prada 2 , Toy Story 5 , The Bear , Avengers Endgame: Encore and others. It also comes with some ESPN programming such as ESPN College GameDay and select live college football games, while Disney+ has the official livestream feed for Super Bowl LXI in February 2027.

Additionally, the bundle offers a wide selection of hot music programming, such as Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour , Olivia Rodrigo: driving home 2 u , Billie Eilish’s Happier Than Ever: A Love Letter to Los Angeles , Oasis: Don’t Look Back in Anger , The Beatles: Get Back , Elton John: Never Too Late and so much more.

For Black Friday week, the Disney+ and Hulu Bundle is starting at just $4.99 per month (regularly $12.99 per month), a 62% savings, for a limited time. Learn more about the streaming deal here .

The Disney+ app is compatible with Apple iPhone and Apple iPad, Android smartphones and tablets, smart TVs from Samsung, Vizio and LG, Roku TV, Google TV and Android TV, Apple TV 4K, Amazon Fire TV and other devices. The service works with web browsers including Google Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
